summary: Frontend-only test of the /minhas-inscricoes.html 'same browser' feature (1920x1080). Full real UI flow executed: termos.html?c=analista -> inscricao.html (CPF 529.982.247-25, RG + front/back upload) -> dados-inscricao.html (Analista Administrativo, Macapá) -> confirmacao.html -> confirm -> inscricao-realizada.html (protocol 2026224725, R$ 120,00). PASS: (1) clicking the header 'Área do Candidato' in the same browser opened /minhas-inscricoes.html with the CPF form hidden, 1 card-inscricao (Nº 2026224725, TEST CANDIDATO AREA, 529.982.247-25, Analista Administrativo, R$ 120,00), the subtitle 'Esta é a inscrição feita neste navegador...' and the btn-consultar-outro-cpf link visible. (2) btn-consultar-outro-cpf shows the form, hides the link and puts focus on cpf-busca. Searching 111.444.777-35 shows 'Nenhuma inscrição encontrada para este CPF.' and 0 cards. (3) Partial storage (stopped at dados-inscricao: CPF set, no __protocolo, no __finalizado_ok): form shown, 0 cards, link hidden. (4) Anonymous fresh context: storage null, form shown, 0 cards. Searching 529.982.247-25 shows the card with the right data, and clicking it goes to /pagamento-pix.html?cpf=..., which uses location.replace to land on /pagamento-pix.html. That page shows 'Chave PIX não configurada' because pix_key is empty, which is expected. FAIL vs spec: in the same-browser case the card click goes to /pagamento-pix.html, NOT to /inscricao-realizada.html as the requirement says.

ui_bugs.issue: The card click goes to '/pagamento-pix.html'. The requirement says it should open /inscricao-realizada.html with the data. Line 82: card({...},'/pagamento-pix.html') should be card({...},'/inscricao-realizada.html').

issues: The #sub-txt subtitle still says 'Esta é a inscrição feita neste navegador. Clique nela...' after the form is reopened, and after a failed search clears the card. It should go back to the default text when the link is clicked.
The CPF in the card from the API search is shown unformatted ('52998224725'). The same-browser card shows '529.982.247-25'. Inconsistent.

action_items: Change the same-browser card href in minhas-inscricoes.html line 82 from '/pagamento-pix.html' to '/inscricao-realizada.html' (per requirement)
Reset #sub-txt to the default text when btn-consultar-outro-cpf is clicked
Format the CPF from the API (j.cpf) as 000.000.000-00 in the search card
critical_code_review_comments: The same-browser card trusts localStorage only (CPF + __protocolo/__finalizado_ok). If an admin deletes the registration, the card still shows 'PENDENTE DE PAGAMENTO'. Consider checking /api/inscricao/resumo/{cpf} in the background.
Unchanged: /api/inscricao/resumo/{cpf} exposes name/cargo by CPF alone; the CPF search has no check-digit validation.
seed_data_creation: Created a test registration for CPF 52998224725 (TEST CANDIDATO AREA). Deleted it afterwards from inscricoes, cadastros, registrations and pix_generated. /api/inscricao/resumo/52998224725 now returns 404. settings.pix_key is ''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh browser, so run the whole flow in one script. Flow: /termos.html?c=analista -> termos-checkbox, btn-continuar-termos -> inscricao.html: NOME, #CPF, #DATA_NASCIMENTO, select[name=SEXO]='0', #CEP 68900-073, #CELULAR, #EMAIL, #DOC_TIPO=RG + set_input_files #DOC_FRENTE/#DOC_VERSO, #declaracao_veracidade, btn-continuar-inscricao -> dados-inscricao: select-vaga index 1 (analista has several), select-municipio-prova 'MACAPA/AP', input[name=termo] (required!), btn-cadastrar -> confirmacao btn-confirmar-inscricao -> conf-success-ok -> inscricao-realizada. Header button has no data-testid in this page; use get_by_text('Área do Candidato').locator('visible=true').first. Cleanup with mongosh by cpf across collections.
